title: Folders group your work across every product
summary: Folders group work across every product, Drive files can be used as inputs, audio-only and 4K exports, Microsoft Translator for memories, bulk review status and a User Actions log.

items.title: Group work from every product in one folder.
items.body: Folders belong to your organization, each with a name, colour and description. Translate Video and Translate Photo processes, Adapts, QC decisions and Cosmos runs can all be filed in the same folder.

items.title: Pick a folder when you start work.
items.body: Choose one when uploading to Translate Video, creating image adaptives in Translate Photo, classifying in QC or starting a Cosmos run. Process lists filter by folder, and **Move to folder** refiles existing work.

items.title: Every folder has a matching Drive folder.
items.body: Creating, renaming or deleting a folder updates its Drive copy, and deliverables saved to Assets are filed there. A folder that still holds work can't be deleted.

items.title: Export audio only.
items.body: Pick **Audio** in the Export panel to get just the mixed voice-over or dub as a WAV file. It replaces the old **Download audio (wav)** menu item and isn't offered for subtitles-only processes.

items.title: 4K and 2K exports.
items.body: Both resolutions can now be chosen when you export.

items.title: Export with issues.
items.body: When a selected language has a detected transcript issue, tick **Export with issues** to export anyway. Lines with missing or invalid dub audio play as silence.

items.title: Separate history for video and audio exports.
items.body: A video export and an audio export for the same language no longer overwrite each other. **Select all** and **Download all** cover both.

items.title: Choose Microsoft Translator per memory.
items.body: VitraTM memories can translate with Azure (Microsoft Translator) instead of Gemini, set when you create or edit the memory. Add the Translator key and region under **Settings → AI Keys**; it is not the Azure Speech key used by Voice & Lipsync.

children.body: Azure translates without your style guide, extra prompt or examples from the memory. Exact memory matches still apply on both engines.
Language lists show only what the memory's engine supports, and an unsupported target language is skipped instead of failing the whole request.
A key without its region, or a region without its key, is rejected when you save, and the **Test** button now checks Translator too.
A wrong key or region shows as a configuration error instead of a generic failure.
The memory list shows a badge on memories that run Azure.
Hyperlocal uses the same organization Translator key.
Smart Match still needs a Gemini key, because its lookups use Gemini.

items.title: Set review status in bulk.
items.body: Status buttons on a memory's terms table and on the Translate Video transcript toolbar set one status across many translations at once, up to 500 per batch. A large run reports how far it got if part of it fails.

items.title: Use files already in Drive as inputs.
items.body: A Drive file picker is available in Translate Video upload, Translate Photo new translations and image adaptives, QC classify and the Cosmos run form.

items.title: The Asset Manager sidebar lists your folders,
items.body: each in its own colour, in place of the project tree. Reloading the page or opening a shared folder link now shows the full path instead of only "My Drive".

items.title: See who did what in your organization.
items.body: **Settings → User Actions** lists actions across every product, with filters, a detail view and links to the affected page. Sign-in and account changes are included, naming the person affected and the previous value.

items.title: Scope a report to one folder.
items.body: Pick a folder beside the dates and members, or choose no folder. A folder-scoped report bills only work in that folder; leaving it empty bills everything in the date range, as before.

items.title: Filter the proofreading report by folder.
items.body: The entries table, member summary and export filter by folder, and the filter is kept in the link so a filtered report can be shared.

items.title: Full language names on invoice PDFs.
items.body: Each line shows one direction, such as English (United States) → Hindi (India), instead of a bare "English → English". Names with special characters no longer lose letters.

items.title: Moving between Asset Manager folders could crash the page
items.body: with "Too many re-renders". Navigating between folders now works.

items.title: Quick Create could wipe your first message.
items.body: Typing the first message in the image creator could clear it with "That chat no longer exists". The chat link is now set only after the message is accepted.

items.title: Inserting alias text added double spaces.
items.body: Aliases in text-to-speech input now insert with single spacing.

items.title: Profile language rates didn't refresh after an edit.
items.body: They now update right away, and sit in an accordion.

items.title: Notifications could show behind other content.
items.body: They now appear on top, with clearer message text.

items.title: Some permission checks blocked work they shouldn't have.
items.body: Subtitle export, sync, the Adapts editor page and tooltips now respect permissions correctly. Translate Video export and permission errors explain more clearly what's missing.

items.title: Review status in the Translate Photo demo editor snapped back.
items.body: Changing a segment's status now sticks.
The export popover no longer shows doubled borders and shadows.
